title: Zurtrutium Lib
body:
# About Zurtrutium Lib
Zurtrutium Lib is a library for Zurtrutium Modding and really only helps with registration and worldgen. 90% of apis are under the tag <ExcentUpdate> which is only available in our workspaces.

Zurtrutium Lib is very small there is no more contents yet. You can wait till the next update.
